name: sofya
description: Web search, page fetch, extraction and cited research from Sofya's own search index. Search returns page content, not just snippets; fetch returns clean markdown, PDFs and Office files included.

interface.shortDescription: Web search, page reading and cited research
interface.longDescription: Search the web and get page content, not just snippets. Read URLs and documents (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint) as clean markdown, pull one fact out of a page, or get a cited research report from many sources. Uses Sofya's hosted MCP server with sign-in, plus two skills that tell the agent when to use each tool.
defaultPrompt: Use Sofya to search the web for the latest release notes of [library] and cite the sources.
Use Sofya to read [URL or PDF] and summarise it.
Use Sofya to research [question] and give me a cited report.
